name: B10-0224/2025 (Renew) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop all planned executions, including of Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani, and to release them. It asks Iran to free Mahvash Sabet and all political prisoners, and to release European citizens held there, including Cécile Kohler and Jacques Paris. It wants the European Union to make better relations with Iran depend on these releases and on ending the death penalty, and to sanction named Iranian officials until then. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- Iran is asked to halt executions and free Ehsani, Hassani, Sabet and EU citizens.
- EU countries should tie better ties with Iran to these releases and sanctions.
- The Parliament sends its demands to EU bodies and the Iranian government.
